fusions.name: Ridden Down
fusions.desc: You rush up to 6 tiles to the target and strike, dealing 14 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds, with a 40% chance to leave it [Pinned] by roots for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Kicked-Up Mould
fusions.desc: Kicks leaf mould ahead of you in a cone, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 20% chance to leave each [Fatigued] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Long-Haul Sap
fusions.desc: Sap runs through your legs: your stamina recovery rises by 40% for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Deep Reserves
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, your roots draw it back: you regain 4 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
